refinement_prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is image 1. Change ONLY the whale hair clip's 3D projection and mounting, keep all other pixels/artwork of girl, hair, face, pose, costume and tail visually unchanged. Image 2 is exact whale contour reference. Existing clip is too frontal. Rotate its face plane around a vertical axis about 35 degrees AWAY from camera, following this left-turning head's temple, so the white whale face is visibly narrower by roughly 20-25 percent compared with current. Keep left-facing rounded whale head, open crescent belly and two-lobed upturned tail still identifiable; no mirroring. Show a clearly visible 6mm midnight navy extruded sidewall along bottom/right, thin cyan bevel on sidewall, restrained seafoam white face. Clip is a solid raised enamel object conforming to skull angle, not flat sticker. Add short compact dark contact shadow on cyan hair and a SMALL cyan hair strand partially crossing the lower mounting stem; do not obscure whale face or tail. No new logos/accessories. Preserve genuine transparent background and all current silhouette edges.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target image 1 is already approved v3 whale girl closeup. Make ONE correction only: REMOVE the two white circular hardware rings on the jacket at lower left and lower right of chest (under the hair, near the lower corners); they are erroneous waist hardware that should not appear in this head-and-upper-chest view. Replace ring areas with continuous clean navy/seafoam jacket panels matching adjacent cloth. Do not change sailor collar, navy neck knot, cyan ribbon, hair strands, face, eye, head tilt, ahoge, fins or beautiful seafoam white dimensional whale hairclip. Preserve the entire existing clip including navy sidewall, shading, exact silhouette, contact shadow, perspective, placement and scale. Do not add any new accessories. Preserve original true alpha transparency and canvas framing.

initial_prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve and compositing. Image 1 is EDIT TARGET: existing original cyan-haired whale girl front bust. Image 2 is EXACT whale silhouette REFERENCE from official DeepSeek mark, not a vague imagined whale. Image 3 is reference ONLY for how a hair accessory sits on hair in an anime lyric MV, never copy its orange hair, flower, ribbons or costume. Produce v3 of SAME whale girl by making just these changes: REMOVE the entire oval chest badge and its rim, replacing it with a small navy neck-ribbon knot matching the clothes, no chest logo. Integrate ONE sculptural whale-shaped enamel HAIR CLIP on character's LEFT temple (viewer RIGHT in this frontal pose), seated immediately above the lateral whale fin and anchored behind two small hair locks. The hair clip face uses the whale silhouette of image 2: left-facing rounded whale head, broad looping open crescent beneath head/body, small eye/open negative detail, upper-right upturned two-lobed fluke, same overall recognizable outline, NO generic fish, NO extra stars, NO letters. Physically formed silhouette-shaped hair ornament, NOT a whale printed inside a disc, not a flat sticker. Body face seafoam white #E6F5F1, extruded sidewall midnight navy #0B2638, tiny restrained ocean cyan bevel #19B5D2. Its front plane follows the tangent of the skull/temple, subtly tilted and foreshortened, visible 3-5mm edge thickness at lower-right, hair partially occludes the hidden mounting clip, compact contact shadow falls onto hair. Keep the emblem big and legible, about 22 percent of head width. Match the figure's cel-shaded graphic style; two or three hard-edged tones create depth without photoreal chrome or glow. Preserve identity, pale face, one visible cyan eye under sweeping bangs, loop ahoge, long layered cyan hair, lateral navy/white whale fins, navy/cyan whale tail behind viewer right, sailor collar, wide sleeves, cuff wave panels and waist straps, original calm smart lonely mood. Preserve flat strong navy/cyan/seafoam masses and existing bust pose. Simplify only dirty pixel fringe into clean antialiased edges. Entire bust, hair ends, tail, loop ahoge inside at least 8 percent real transparent margin, nothing cropped. Transparent PNG background. NO flower, no orange, no violet or royal blue, NO compass or circular badge.
